value: This document outlines various experimental tools developed within the arXivLabs framework, aimed at enhancing research dissemination and discovery. These community-contributed features span critical aspects of the research workflow, including advanced bibliographic and citation management (e.g., Connected Papers, scite.ai), robust platforms for sharing code, data, and media (e.g., Huggingface, DagsHub), interactive research demonstrations (e.g., Replicate, Spaces), and efficient related paper recommenders. Embodying arXiv's commitment to openness, community, excellence, and user data privacy, arXivLabs provides a collaborative environment for integrating valuable new functionalities directly into the arXiv platform.
